nodes.label: Pull Request Checks Workflow
nodes.rationale: Python tests, mypy, and the API spec drift check run inside a built devcontainer rather than on the bare runner, so CI executes against the same image contributors develop in. Docs and GitHub template paths are ignored to avoid running the whole matrix on non-code changes. The web unit test step is commented out; only lint, i18n key extraction, build, and Playwright E2E run for the frontend.

edges.source_location: both gate the dev branch but split responsibilities: pull_request runs lint/type/test, ci builds and pushes images
python_tests builds a devcontainer whose relationship to docker/main's dependency stack is not stated in either file
